Dungeons & Dolphins bundled campaigns

Campaigns are declarative scene files loaded by DNDAdventure. Bundled entries are listed in index.txt.

Reef Wardens demonstrates exploration, checks, rewards, flags, achievements and milestones.
Ghost Protocol is a fictional authorized security-audit adventure using a Flipper Zero as an in-world inspection tool; it contains branching skill checks but no real exploit instructions.

See CAMPAIGN_PACK_SCHEMA.md for the third-party format. User campaigns remain under DNDAdventure app data and packaged files are never rewritten.
